title: The Boy Who Cried Wolf
text: A young shepherd watched his flock on a quiet hillside every day. Bored and looking for excitement, he shouted, "Wolf! Wolf!" just to see the villagers come running to help. When they arrived and found no wolf, they were annoyed and returned home. The shepherd laughed and tried the same trick again a few days later, and again the villagers came for nothing. One evening, a real wolf crept out of the forest and began attacking the sheep. The shepherd screamed for help, but this time no one came, because they no longer believed him.
comprehension_hint_topics: why no one came to help the shepherd this time
